Welcome to the future of energy

Octopus is a tech-powered energy company. We believe technology has the power to address our greatest challenge, climate change, while also delivering incredible service and customer experience.

We are changing the way people interact with their energy company - by making it approachable, low cost, easy-to-understand, and most importantly, 100% renewable.

Want to work in a soul-destroying customer service call center?
Don’t apply here.
 
We’re a bit different...
You won’t believe it until you actually start working here. We try to explain it during the application and interview process but really, until you’re immersed in our culture, you’ll realize you’ve never worked anywhere like it. 
 
At Octopus you’re not a number. You're a human and we treat you like one. And that’s how we want our customers to feel too. We want you to help our customers - like genuinely help. Like out of the box, what can I do here to make a difference to this customer, help? Crazy huh?
 
You’ll chat to customers over the phone and via email while being given the freedom to help them in a way you too would like to be helped. You’ll take ownership of their needs and find a way, no matter what, to figure things out with them.
 
We treat all of our customers like our grannies, (No offense intended - we really love our grannies) - with patience, kindness and warmth. We could tell you so many stories of the relationships customers have built with us as if we were family. Would you believe they send us poems, artwork, handwritten letters, photos of their family, babies and pets? It’s bonkers and we love it. 
 
We call it the Octopus effect.
It won't take long for those tentacles to wrap around your heart once you join us. Your colleagues will be some of the most amazing people you’ll be lucky enough to call friends. They are the most enthusiastic, determined, curious crew who love being part of disrupting the energy industry but also sharing our mission to humanize the customer service experience. 
 
We don’t lie - it’s not easy.
Learning in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment isn’t for the faint-hearted. Every day you will come across problems not seen before, and you’ll be tasked with bringing about awesome solutions. Expect the unexpected. Ask questions, drive change ,and share your ideas.
 
There’s a lot (and we mean a lot) to learn, and a lot of work to do. Just when you think you know everything there is to know - something changes. We’ll help you build your knowledge and be committed to your development. If you’ve got the attitude to thrive here and want to make a difference - we’ll go that extra mile for you.

- Talk to our customers over the phone or via email, resolving their queries and perhaps engaging with other suppliers too.

- Working in Operations, you’ll be at the heart of everything we do - helping our customers.

- Taking full responsibility for all issues that you come across, you’ll be delivering end to end customer service. Gone are the days of customers getting stuck in a never ending loop of being transferred between departments, you’ll be fully trained in every aspect of the customer experience and be able to help with any problem.

- Every day, you’ll be tasked with bringing about awesome solutions while keeping up with rapid fire change as we grow. Expect the unexpected.

- Fluency in Spanish is strongly preferred

- Prior energy experience isn't required - we'll happily meet you where you're at and teach you what you need to know! We just ask that you have a passion for sustainability and providing world-class customer service!

- Highly motivated and lots of drive to succeed is a must

- MS Office Suite Proficient

- Highly organized

- Energetic

- Quick Learner

- Takes instruction easily and follows through

- Candidates must be available to work a standard schedule of Monday-Friday, 9:00am - 5:30pm.

- Bachelor’s or Associate's Degree

- Excited to help customers - Customers are at the center of everything we do. From the CEO to our Data Scientists, everyone across the business deals with customers. In Operations, we’re at the forefront and the main point of call for all our customers and it will be your main responsibility to go to the ends of the earth to keep our customers impressed and excited about Octopus Energy being their energy supplier.

- Open minded - We’re a rapidly growing company, which means sometimes things go wrong, and we don’t shy away from this. We take everything as a learning curve and expect you to as well, being proactive in spotting weak areas and suggesting solutions and improvements to the customer’s experience.

- Approachable - Everything we do in operations, and across Octopus, is built around teamwork. People in our teams are always there to support and help each other and we expect everyone to be a team player.

- Inclusive - We are looking to continue building our wonderful, inclusive culture full of enthusiastic, unique and diverse people from all backgrounds as we grow and continue to change the industry.

- Dedicated to sustainability - As a renewable energy supplier, those who are a part of our team are also deeply committed to helping in any way they can in their own lives in the fight against climate change and making a positive impact for the future.

- Committed to improvement - Our energy specialists are the main point of call for our customers and their input hugely shapes the customer journey. We are looking for people who will actively looking for ways in which we can improve the customer experience and not be afraid to speak up.

- A strong work ethic - A role in operations is very fast paced and can be challenging at times. We’re looking for people who can deal with challenging situations and who are responsible for their own future by working extremely hard to achieve their goals.

- Innovation-Led Culture: Be part of a company that leads with innovative solutions and challenges traditional industry norms.

- Impactful Work: Your contributions will directly influence our growth and help shape the future of sustainable energy.

- Collaborative Environment: Work in a dynamic, supportive environment that fosters creative thinking and problem-solving.

- Fully paid medical, dental, and vision insurance options.

- Paid time off — we know working hard means also being able to recharge as needed, we trust our employees to get the work done and take the time they need. Octopus offers 20 days paid vacation, 8 paid sick days, and discretionary unlimited paid time off.

- 401(k) plan with employer match. Octopus matches 100% of contributions on the first 3% and 50% of contributions from 3-5%.

- Parental leave. Biological, adoptive and foster parents are all eligible. We pay 16 weeks at full pay and then an additional 8 weeks at half pay.

- Pre-tax commuter benefits.

- Equity Options: every Octopus employee owns part of the business. We’re a team, working together towards huge goals. Every person is crucial to our success, you should be rewarded as such.

- Wondering what the salary for this role is? Just ask us! When on a call with one of our recruiters it's something we always cover as we genuinely want to match your experience with the correct salary. The reason why we don't advertise is because we honestly have a degree of flexibility and would never want salary to be a reason why someone doesn't apply to Octopus - what's more important to us is finding the right octofit!

- Interagire con i clienti per recupero crediti.

- Octopus Energy è un luogo in cui le persone hanno spazio per imparare, prendersi responsabilità e fare davvero la differenza. Lavoriamo con autonomia e fiducia, crediamo che l’impegno vada riconosciuto con benefici che contano davvero per chi lavora con noi.

What we do. Electric Car Leasing

Why we do it. Greener. Fairer. Future.

We’re expanding our Electric Vehicle Sales Team in Weybridge. We're looking for an Electric Vehicles Sales Specialist, who will be responsible for managing sales directly with our customers focusing on our salary sacrifice product.  
 
You will be the face and the voice of the Octopus Electric Vehicles, advising and supporting customers throughout their journey towards purchasing an EV. You will discuss their requirements and find the perfect vehicle for their lifestyle, considering the salary sacrifice product fully and the benefits of going electric.  
 
We’re all about growth - both for the business and for our people. We provide plenty of opportunities for career progression, continuous learning, and personal development. Whether you're eager to level up your skills or thrive in our fast paced environment, we’re here to support your journey and help you make an impact.
 
A genuine passion for customer experience and sustainability is a must with a strong understanding of process and the importance of customer service.
 
This role will include an uncapped commission scheme and a generous car allowance as part of the overall package and will be based in our brand new office Weybridge 3 days a week.

- Speak to customers interested in leasing an electric vehicle and qualifying the right one for them

- Manage the end to end sales pipeline with customers - from lead through to delivery and deliver sales in line with targets

- Manage customer orders in progress and supervise order processing

- Continue planning and targeting of the acquisition of new customers

- Recording customer satisfaction to ensure that customers are having the best experience

- Provide excellent customer service both through the sales process and also in after-sales customer care

- Strategically build your pipeline working with the team to create strong relationships both with internal stakeholders as well as with our customers both on a consumer and business level

- Some sales experience welcome, whether that's in a customer-facing role, recruitment, or anywhere you've had to persuade, pitch, or close

- Experience in technology-driven sales processes (CRM, digital sales)

- Proven track record of working in a target driven role and providing excellent customer experiences

- Strong communication skills, a passionate drive, resilience, and a humble attitude

- An inquisitive nature with the ability to gather information to align customer needs with tailored solutions

- A genuine passion for going above and beyond for customers and a strong passion for Electric Vehicles, sustainability and/or the automotive industry

- A start up / entrepreneurial mind-set being able to adjust to change and keep up with a fast moving business

- A constant focus on improving and developing personally and within a business

- Ideally if you have previous experience within fleet, leasing or selling a salary sacrifice product - this is a bonus!

jobs.description:
宇宙に「緑」の大穴をあけるために、力を貸してください！ 世界中で再生可能エネルギー革命を推進するミッションを実現するため、より多くの人の協力が必要なのです。

＜ご応募の際は日本語の職務経歴書をご提出ください＞

年次有給休暇23日／東京ガスと英国オクトパスエナジーの合弁会社

わたしたちは「グリーンな電力」をお手頃価格で提供地球に優しいグリーンな電力を手頃な価格で提供する会社です。
近年世界中で注目の「再生可能エネルギー」を日本にも普及させるため、2021年に東京ガスと電力会社オクトパスエナジーが共同出資して誕生しました。

＜わたしたちはこういう会社です＞
・出社と同時に自分の個性を包み隠さなくてはならないような職場ではなく、本来の自分でいられるような会社にしたい。なぜならその人物こそが我々が採用した人であり、ありのままの自分で同僚とやりとりしたり、お客様の応対をしてほしいから。その人の本質を尊重し、ありのままの自分で居られて、自ら創造性を高めて仕事に大いに貢献してもらえるような会社でありたい。そのためにも、社員がインスパイアされモチベーションを高められリラックスできる空間と合わせて、世界中の方々をお迎えする空間作りを行っている。
・オクトパスの原理は、昔の建築の石垣の原理。つまり、２つと無いユニークな形の自然石同士の合わせの良さで強度を持たせて、何千年も持ち堪えることができる仕組みを大事にしている。だからこそありのままの自分を出してほしい。
・自由と責任は比例する。みなさんには自由を持って働いてほしい。ソファに体をうずめて脚を投げ出した格好で仕事をしても良いし、好きな音楽を聴きながらでもいいし、服装も完全自由。休暇の申請も妥当なタイミングで良い。出勤退勤の打刻も必要無い。就業規則は最小限の内容。ただし自由には責任が伴う。自由と適切なプレッシャーを同時に味わいながら、常に昨日の自分よりも成長してほしいし邁進してほしい。
・負荷をかけるというと、大企業では「苦手なことをさせる」場合が多いが、オクトパスでは皆が得意分野に取り組んで、オリジナリティを活かす。それこそが組織の強靭化につながる。なので、ITがやりたいならITを、営業なら営業、企画なら企画、好きなことで最大限あなたの力を活かしてほしい。そしていま私たちは、カスタマーサービスがやりたい人を探している。
・ミスは表彰する。ミスが起きたとき、ミスをミスと認めることが肝要。そしてそれを責めず、寛容さをもって受け入れる。時には表彰して茶化す(笑)。皆が皆理由があってここにいるのだから、皆で支え合うのが当たり前。

- 週休二日制です。
- オペレーション部門にて、日本のお客様をサポートするすべての業務の中心となっていただきます。
- お客様が直面するすべての問題に全責任を持ち、エンド・ツー・エンドのカスタマーサービスを提供します。
- もう、お客様が部署間をたらい回しにされるようなことはありません。
- 顧客体験のあらゆる側面について完全に訓練され、業界全体のトレーニングが提供されます。
- お客様からの問い合わせに全責任を持ち、適切な解決策を提供できるようになることが期待されます。
- 予想外のことも想定してください。
- エネルギーの経験は必要ありません。オクトパスではこれまでとは異なるやり方をしますので、必ずしも役立つとは限りません！主体性のある方を求めています。柔軟でダイナミックな機会を探している方なら学歴・年齢不問。新卒の方でも、子育て中の方でも、フレキシブルでダイナミックなお仕事をお探しの方なら大歓迎です。

- 日本のお客様へ電話サポートができるレベルの日本語力 - わたしたちは日本のお客様に日本語でサポートとサービスを提供しています。トレーニングも日本語で行われます。そのため日本語の読み書き、および会話が今現在すでに流暢な方でなければ、日本でのエナジースペシャリストの仕事は難しいです。
- カスタマーサポートへの情熱 - お客様は私たちのすべての活動の中心です。オクトパスエナジーでは、CEOからデータ・サイエンティストに至るまで、社員全員がお客様と接しています。オクトパスエナジーが、エネルギーサプライヤーとしてお客様に感動と興奮を与え続けられるために、地の果てまで赴くことがあなたの主な責任となります。
- オープンマインド - わたしたちは急成長中の企業であり、時にはうまくいかないこともあります。何事も学習曲線と捉え、積極的に弱点を発見し、解決策を提案し、顧客体験を改善することが期待されます。
- 親しみやすい - オペレーション部門はもちろん、オクトパスではチームワークを大切にしています。オクトパスでは、チームの全員が常にお互いをサポートし、助け合い、チームプレーヤーであることが期待されます。
- インクルーシブ（排他的じゃない） - オクトパスが成長し、業界を変革し続けるために、わたしたちの組織はあらゆるバックグラウンドを持つ、熱意と個性にあふれた多様な人材で構成されています。そして素晴らしいインクルーシブな企業文化を築き続けたいと考えています。排他的な考えをしがちな人には不向きな仕事です。
- 持続可能性への献身 - 再生可能エネルギーを供給する立場として、気候変動との闘いにおいて自分自身の生活の中でできる限りの支援をし、未来に良い影響を与えることに深くコミットしていただきます。
- 改善へのコミットメント - 今回募集するエナジースペシャリストという仕事はお客様との主な窓口であり、エナジー・スペシャリストの意見や提案は顧客体験に大きな影響を与えています。ですので、顧客体験を改善する方法を積極的に探し、発言することを恐れない人材を求めています。
- 仕事に対する強い倫理観 - オペレーションの仕事は非常にペースが速く、時には困難なこともあります。言い訳したくなる事もあるでしょう。しかしわたしたちは、困難な状況に対処して目標達成のために懸命に努力することで、自分の将来に責任を持てる人材を求めています。取得した経験やスキルや仲間からの信頼は、すべてあなた個人の財産です。

- 勤務地：東京都港区六本木１−４−５アークヒルズサウスタワー１８階
- 交通：東京メトロ南北線「六本木一丁目駅」より徒歩１分
- 勤務時間：フレックスタイム制（標準労働7.5時間）＊9:00-17:00は電話対応がある時間帯なのでこの時間帯に従事できることを期待されます。残業は月平均10〜20時間
- 年間休日：121日
- 週休2日制。六本木のオフィスへ出勤していただきます。
- 年末年始休暇
- 年次有給休暇は入社初日から23日間付与します
- 産休・育休
- 介護休暇
- 慶弔休暇
- 上司判断による追加の有給休暇もあります

jobs.description:
Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.8 on Trustpilot, based on 55,000+ reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75 (more about our culture here).
Our journey: Founded in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.
Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.
AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Join us as Social Media Manager Italy to define and execute Qonto's social media strategy across Instagram, LinkedIn, and YouTube for the Italian market. You'll drive brand awareness, engagement, and customer acquisition through culturally resonant content, influencer collaborations, and data-driven campaigns. You will report to Marta Rifà Llimós, Head of Southern Europe Marketing.
➡️ What you'll do
Own the social strategy for Italy: Define the channel mix, content types (entertainment, product, educational, corporate), and calendar across IG, LinkedIn, and YouTube — with full autonomy.
Build and run the content calendar: Coordinate the monthly publishing plan across Design, Press, Events, PMM, Community, and external agencies. You ensure on-time delivery and strategic coherence.
Create content hands-on: Shoot and edit video/photo content using CapCut, Edits, Figma, or similar tools. Be comfortable on camera — you bring Qonto's Italian brand to life through owned content.
Run paid social campaigns: Manage LinkedIn campaigns directly, coordinate Instagram paid with our Italian agency, and support YouTube Ads with the media team.
Track performance and evolve strategy: Extract KPIs, draw conclusions, and systematically apply learnings. You use data to evolve your approach, not just report on it.
➡️ What we're looking for
3 years as the in-house social media owner for an Italian brand — not agency-side. You've designed and executed the full channel strategy across IG, LinkedIn, and YouTube solo, without an account manager or team below you. B2B or scale-up experience strongly preferred
Italian copywriting excellence: sharp, error-free, culturally resonant. You localise, not translate. Perfect written and oral Italian and English.
Data fluency: You work with Sprout, Google Analytics, Looker Studio (or equivalents) and you can walk through a campaign's performance metric by metric and tell me what you changed as a result — not just that results were positive
Influencer management: You've run creator campaigns end-to-end — sourcing, briefing, negotiation, performance tracking. You've owned the full cycle.
Paid social experience: You've managed LinkedIn campaigns and can brief an agency on Instagram paid with clear objectives and creative direction.
➡️ What we can offer you
Full ownership of a market: You define Italy's social strategy and you execute it. No committee approvals — you own the output and the results.
A growing content playground: Podcast, influencer collaborations, events coverage, video production — the formats are expanding and you'll shape what comes next.
Cross-functional collaboration across Southern Europe: You'll work daily with Design, Press, Events, PMM, Community, and Qonto's global social media team. Marta's team covers Italy, Spain, and Portugal — three markets, shared learnings.
AI-first environment: Daily experimentation with AI tools is expected. You'll have access to the best tools on the market to evolve your craft.
➡️ Your future manager
Your manager will be Marta Rifà Llimós, Head of Marketing Southern Europe, based in Barcelona.
Her path? 10+ years in digital marketing across Southern European markets. Marta spent 5+ years at Engel & Völkers growing from Digital Marketing Assistant to Marketing Manager Iberia, then led EU performance and cross-channel marketing at Birchbox. She joined Qonto in 2022 as Marketing Lead Spain, built the market from the ground up, and was promoted to Head of Marketing Southern Europe in 2025 — now leading Italy, Spain, and Portugal.
What does she bring to the team? A hands-on, data-driven leadership style with deep multi-market experience. She's built marketing operations from scratch and knows what it takes to grow a market. She runs a flat team where ideas are welcomed and ownership is expected.
